description: This file defines the 'Store' controller in the OpenCart admin backend, handling store listing, creation, editing, deletion, and rebuilding configurations.

classes.name: Store
classes.description: Controller class for managing store configurations within OpenCart's admin panel, including listing, creating, editing, deleting, and rebuilding store entries.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles the display of the store list page, setting up breadcrumbs, loading necessary views, and passing data.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns the list of stores, typically for AJAX or API calls, by invoking getList.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML view for the store list, optionally paginated, including store data and links.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for creating or editing a store, pre-populating data if editing an existing store.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving store data, validating permissions and input, and updating or creating store records.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected store records after permission and dependency checks.

methods.name: rebuild
methods.description: Rebuilds or resets store configurations, with permission checks.
